pencereler.0-5: It caused chemical burns to people and animals. A reservoir wall at a Hungarian
pencereler.5-12: alumina plant suddenly broke. A flood of red mud swept through nearby villages, and ten people were killed. The
pencereler.12-20: mud was waste from making aluminium. It was strongly alkaline. It flowed into rivers and reached the Danube. The reservoir had been
pencereler.20-30: inspected shortly before. Hungary then tightened rules for industrial waste reservoirs.

segmentler.metin: The Ajka alumina reservoir flooded villages with caustic red mud.
It took only a corner of a waste reservoir wall giving way.
So how could a corner of a waste reservoir wall giving way do this?
The answer is structural failure of a reservoir dyke holding highly alkaline bauxite residue — and it is why Hungary tightened industrial waste reservoir regulation.
